deliberately_mislabeled.why_mislabeled: Free-text field - operators paste full card numbers here during approval process
deliberately_mislabeled.example_value: Loan approved. Customer card on file: 4532-1111-2222-3333 for auto-pay setup.
deliberately_mislabeled.detection_method: Custom regex for card PAN format (4532...) - must detect in free text
deliberately_mislabeled.detection_difficulty: HARD - requires text parsing, not schema inspection
deliberately_mislabeled.business_impact: If card PAN leaks in loan memo, we fail data governance audit

deliberately_mislabeled.why_mislabeled: Looks innocent (BR_01, BR_02...) but combined with CUSTOMER name + DOB = re-identification risk
deliberately_mislabeled.detection_method: Data minimization - branch only needed in row access policy, not in MARTS output to analysts

deliberately_mislabeled.why_mislabeled: Free text memo - may contain sensitive context
deliberately_mislabeled.example_value: Medical reimbursement - Dr. Smith Oncology Center
deliberately_mislabeled.detection_method: Sentiment analysis + keyword detection (medical, legal, etc.) - would require Cortex NLP

deliberately_mislabeled.why_mislabeled: Appears numeric, but reveals real estate/asset values tied to customer
deliberately_mislabeled.detection_method: Requires masking at certain tiers to prevent wealth inference attacks

testing_guidance: Block 2 will run classification profile to detect all confirmed_sensitive columns. For deliberately_mislabeled columns: precision/recall report shows which reviewers caught manually.
